title: Wolff-Parkinson-White Detection at 471:1 Class Imbalance: A Leakage-Controlled Study of the Data Bottleneck
abstract: arXiv:2608.14633v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) syndrome is a congenital cardiac pre-excitation, clinically important and often missed on the resting 12-lead ECG. Detection is hard: the signature is subtle and the condition rare. We pool two public 12-lead corpora, PTB-XL and Chapman-Shaoxing-Ningbo: 66,951 recordings, 142 of them WPW, a prevalence of 0.21% (about 471:1). Under one pre-specified, leakage-controlled protocol, with a held-out fold contacted exactly once, we compare seven representations of the signal, holding the split and the evaluation fixed. Within these corpora and under a modest compute budget, added diversity and capacity do not raise the ceiling: the most orthogonal detector significantly hurts, a feature-union model matches a two-member vote, a convolutional network reaches the wavelet detector without exceeding it, and self-supervised pretraining fails a pre-specified gate. translated_abstract: 沃尔夫-帕金森-怀特综合征是一种先天性的心脏预激综合征，具有重要的临床意义，但在静息12导联心电图上常被漏诊。其检测困难：特征细微且该病罕见。我们合并了两个公共12导联数据集，即PTB-XL和Chapman-Shaoxing-Ningbo：共66,951条记录，其中142条为WPW，患病率为0.21%（约471:1）。在预先指定、控制泄漏的协议下，保持保留折仅接触一次，我们比较了信号的七种表示，并固定了数据划分和评估方法。在这些数据集中，在适度的计算预算下，增加多样性和容量并未提高上限：最正交的检测器显著降低性能，特征联合模型与两成员投票相当，卷积网络达到小波检测器水平而未超过，自监督预训练未能通过预设门槛。一个无泄漏的学习曲线，在每一步重新选择特征，显示...
tldr: 本研究在严格防泄漏协议下，系统比较了七种信号表示方法对罕见WPW综合征的检测性能，发现增加模型复杂度和数据多样性无法突破性能上限，揭示了数据瓶颈是主要限制因素。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares seven signal representations for detecting rare Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome under a strict leakage-controlled protocol, finding that added model complexity and data diversity fail to improve performance, revealing the data bottleneck as the primary limiting factor.
